item.text: I found one semantic gap unrelated to formatting: Python rejects integer literals like `01` during `eval`. I’m tightening the literal parser there so invalid decimal integers fail instead of silently normalizing.

test2.mjs: error: argument --a: expected one argument

item.text: `argparse` is a little looser than the Python evaluator here: it accepts `-01` as the value for `--a`, then `eval` fails later. I’m separating “looks like a negative value token” from actual literal validity so that edge case lines up too.
